title: shipped 6 PRs today
summary: qwen3.5 397b is now live. you can finally upload files on the play page. also fixed a stubborn kv caching bug that was ignoring api key permission changes, which was a great time. homepage got some fresh paint too

highlights.title: Drag-and-Drop Uploads
highlights.text: You can now upload local images (up to 5MB) directly on the Play page instead of hunting for URLs.

highlights.title: Omniscient Model Monitor
highlights.text: The model monitor now tracks audio and video models alongside text and images, so you know exactly what's up (or down).

highlights.title: Qwen3.5 397B Arrives
highlights.text: We've added Qwen3.5 397B to the [Unified API](https://gen.pollinations.ai). Massive 262K context window, vision, and reasoning capabilities are now a single endpoint away.
